title: Tellscript front matter
description: The YAML block at the top of every .tell.md file. Tellscript format, draft 0.1.

tell.description: Level and name, for example feature/cart. Must match the file path.

checks.description: Check files, reference images or recorded flows.

binds.description: Contracts this file touches, with the exact route, type or table after #.

recipe.description: Recipes for pictures, texts or data.

rationale.description: Decisions that explain rules in this file.

proof.description: Proof level, written by the check run.

features.description: Product files: feature names in reading order.

tokens.description: Product files: the design token file.

model.description: Recipe files: model, variant and size.

refs.description: Recipe files: references the model is given.

lineage.description: Recipe files: which outputs come from this recipe.
